comments.author: suargi
comments.body: This behavior is not related to SB3 but to Gymansium. And it is the expected behavior - not an issue at all. I should have checked it befroe opening the issue here. Sorry.

comments.author: suargi
comments.body:
In Gymnasium one can access the original space by using the unwrapped attribute.
In SB3 one can do `envs.get_attr("unwrapped")[0].action_space` to have access to the original action space, at least when using SubprocVecEnv.
